master_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the canonical full-length studio bottle for nineteen COLOUR-ONLY editions. FIRST image is the edit target and authority for the tall slim body, overall proportions, camera, framing, base, fabric strap route and floor contact. SECOND image is the original solid Blender lid geometry. THIRD image is the corrected polished photoreal lid material/shape reference. Correct ONLY the first image's lid hardware and removable strap hooks; preserve the body outline and entire frame exactly. Retain portrait1024x1536 warm ivory studio background, body x~308–709 from y450 to1370, fully open hood top around y35 and collar y350–455, one continuous U-shaped ivory woven strap draped around the body and across the floor. Lid hardware must match the Blender/corrected reference: smooth clear circular hood with narrow edge; flat round TRANSLUCENT SILICONE sealing pad on a short diagonal neck mounted towards the upper-right rear inside the hood, NEVER an opaque white ball on a tall vertical stem; LOW folded straw assembly in small rectangular hinged support front-left, with charcoal mouth tip and curved short stem; SHORT rear-centre cylindrical SPRAY HEAD; squat hourglass open drinking SPOUT front-right; simple oval ivory latch with small horizontal inset. All metal parts smooth MIRROR-POLISHED stainless steel, crisp dark/light photographic highlights, no brushed grain. No invented tall pipes or extra mouthpieces. Two opening detachable swivel snap hooks, each with clearly visible spring gate and thumb release, attach the ONE continuous woven strap to the two side rings. Preserve the strap width, upper stitched tabs, folds, route and positions so exact website vector animal prints can remain centred at the same coordinates. Keep body, lid collar and fabric all white/ivory for this canonical neutral master. Existing full-bottle silhouette and proportions remain unchanged. Keep the bottle body, strap and lower body COMPLETELY BLANK: no words, logos, animals, dots or braille, because precise original branding and braille are composited as SVG layers by the website and must not be regenerated. Exceptionally crisp premium product photography, physically plausible clear plastic, soft translucent silicone, polished steel and visible fine woven fibres. No mist in this idle studio view. This is a correction to the same product, never a new bottle design.
